verdict.rationale: This story asks about autonomous background automations, which is an agent or automation-platform capability. It is outside the role of a dependency installer and package manager like Bun's `bun install`/`bun pm`. Nothing in the evidence shows Bun's package manager shipping scheduled or background automation. Lifecycle scripts and `--concurrent-scripts` are install-time behaviors, not autonomous automations, so they do not make the axis apply.
